requested: implement the final v024 command-gated phase-contact Source Oracle in one bounded unit

identities.contract: human-confirmed 2026-09-07 Reward ordering and module test cards

review.scope: v024 plan ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, ML evidence and proof route

source_edits.scope: local reversible v024 source, config, tests and documents

report_write.scope: local plan, cards and validation receipts

repository_discipline.rationale: Contract-first, owner-layer, config-first, backend-isolation and validate-near-risk rules govern this unit.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: walk_commands owns canonical command state, walk_control owns phase and PD control facts, walk_reward owns pure costs, bindings only transact state and gather public sensors.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The v024 path uses canonical commands, public net-contact sensors, cached gains and public actuator force limits.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Environment bindings depend on pure owners; no script rule, backend subclass capability probe or private method is planned.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Old-command reward phase precedes Reward; resampled command transition commits only to the next observation/action; reset torque is explicit and actual-step torque fails closed.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: One separate selector/profile activates v024 while v022/v023 retain their existing paths.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Module and config tests do not claim simulator reachability, learning or policy quality.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: RED/GREEN covers command boundaries, phase transaction provenance, contact truth table, null quality terms, torque provenance, config identity and legacy characterization.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Actor/critic command and phase dimensions remain unchanged; v024 changes values and persisted behavior identity only.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: This unit changes environment Reward and state inputs without changing SAC optimizer or gradient ownership.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema 3 remains unchanged and behavior_profile plus existing effective config hashes reject same-shape stale checkpoints.

residual_risks.description: A bounded MuJoCo reset/step smoke establishes initial simulator reachability, but update, checkpoint round-trip, learnability and policy quality remain unproven.
residual_risks.disposition: Require the full formal runtime audit before a separately authorized 5000-iteration training run.
